evidence: In 3d_top, 3d_iso and 3d_iso_back every body (RJ45 magjack, QFP, headers, crystal, passives) is visibly separated from its neighbors with no intersecting or stacked bodies.
Both iso views show all bodies seated flush on the top surface with no floating, sunken, or tilted parts; the RJ45 overhang past the edge is normal jack geometry.
3d_top body positions match the 2d pad locations (QFP centered on its pad ring, header bodies over their pin pads, magjack shield posts on the SH holes) with no displaced footprint.
The RJ45 opening faces outward over the nearest board edge (visible in 3d_iso_back), the vertical pin headers mate upward, and there are no relays or polarized parts to misorient.
No RF module or antenna keepout exists on this board; not applicable.

In 2d the SPI header J2 and power header J3 are stranded far from the U1 PHY cluster with long crossing ratsnest lines, the entire bottom half of the board is empty, and the C1/R3/C2 and R1/R2/C3 reference labels pile on top of each other showing ragged, crowded sub-clusters rather than clean grid-aligned groups.
